label: New Testament, John 21.15-17: John reports that the risen Jesus three times asks Simon son of John…
interpretation: 21.15: 'boske ta arnia mou'; 21.16: 'poimaine ta probatia mou'; 21.17: 'boske ta probatia mou'. Read as a report that Jesus charges Peter with shepherding (feeding and tending) Jesus' own flock; CommissionReport.powers jn21 = [shepherd]. Context read: the whole of chapter 21, including 21.14 (the third appearance to the disciples after being raised), 21.18-19 (Peter's death foretold) and 21.24 (the disciple who testifies to these things and wrote them; 'we know that his testimony is true'). Limits: textual report only; the flock is not identified with a particular society; 21.24 is the Gospel's own claim to true testimony, not an independent confirmation.
